scope: Source-led US utility/EPO/PCT documentation profile; mechanical checks, disclosure sufficiency and legal filing acceptance are separate. EPO is not synonymous with the European Union.

sources.title: USPTO MPEP §608.02 — Drawing
sources.readingDepth: Selected drawing/completeness/correction passages read from the official §608 page; not all 874 kB.
sources.finding: Necessary drawings and consistent disclosure matter; later drawings cannot cure original insufficient disclosure or add original claim scope.
sources.limit: MPEP guidance is distinct from the current regulation; displayed subsection revision is January 2024.

sources.title: 37 CFR §1.84 — Standards for drawings
sources.readingDepth: Current eCFR title displayed as of 13 November 2026. Selected drawing standards read.
sources.finding: A4 or US Letter, specified margins, black-line default, ≥3.2 mm characters, consistent references and US figure/sheet rules.
sources.limit: Current regulation text retrieved; not an audit of every filing channel, exception or application type.

sources.title: EPC Rule46 — deleted historical form-of-drawings provision
sources.readingDepth: Current official page and deletion/version-history note read; historical text distinguished from current law.
sources.finding: Deleted effective 1 February 2023 by CA/D10/22; do not cite former Rule46 as the current drawing authority.
sources.limit: Historical text remains displayed on the official page and can mislead a title-only reading.

sources.title: EPC Rule42 — content of description
sources.readingDepth: Full short operative description provision read.
sources.finding: Technical field, background art, problem/solution, figures, at least one detailed way of carrying out, industrial applicability where not obvious.
sources.limit: A description template cannot supply absent enabling parameters or establish a claimed technical effect.

sources.title: EPC Rule43 — form and content of claims
sources.readingDepth: Selected technical-feature, dependent-claim, numbering and reference-sign provisions read.
sources.finding: Claims define technical features; number claims; avoid reliance on figures alone; parenthesised reference signs may aid intelligibility without limiting the claim.
sources.limit: No legal claim drafting or novelty/inventive-step conclusion for the repositories is provided.

sources.title: EPC Article83 — disclosure of invention
sources.readingDepth: Full short operative disclosure provision read.
sources.finding: Disclose sufficiently clearly and completely for a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention.
sources.limit: A neat drawing does not satisfy sufficiency when necessary operating information is missing.

sources.title: EPO Guidelines2026 F-II4.1 — general description remarks
sources.finding: Description enables practice and understanding of the contribution to the art.
sources.limit: Guidance on examination, not a substitute for the EPC or case-specific legal assessment.

sources.title: PCT Rule11 — physical requirements of international application
sources.finding: A4, drawing margins, minimal words, black-line drawings, ≥3.2mm drawing characters and consistent reference signs.
sources.limit: PCT international-phase rules differ from EPO regional electronic practice; request-text2.1mm and ordinary-text2.8mm are not drawing-glyph minima.

sources.title: EPC Rule49(2) — presentation requirements delegated to EPO President
sources.readingDepth: Selected current paragraph and references read; tracked/deleted prior paragraphs not treated as current authority.
sources.finding: The President determines presentation requirements; page links OJ2025A49 and A57.
sources.limit: Current and struck/deleted historical wording coexist in the page; use the current President decision for mechanical details.

sources.title: EPO President decision25November2022 — OJ2022A113
sources.section: Arts1,2 and entry-into-force; supersession checked against2025A49 Art6
sources.readingDepth: Selected drawing/presentation provisions and successor supersession text read.
sources.finding: Former delegated presentation requirements, superseded on 1 October 2025 by OJ2025A49.
sources.limit: Not the current EPO drawing authority.

sources.title: EPO Guidelines2026 A-IX3 — paper-drawing conditions
sources.section: A-IX3 paper conditions and current decision reference
sources.readingDepth: Selected paper/reproduction paragraphs and A49 cross-reference read.
sources.finding: Paper conditions remain relevant to paper filings; the page updates its decision reference to2025A49.
sources.limit: Not used as an electronic-colour prohibition; current A49 controls that distinction.

sources.title: EPO Guidelines2026 F-III1 — sufficiency
sources.section: F-III1 selected first,third and structure/function paragraphs
sources.readingDepth: Selected essential-feature, whole-area-claimed and structure/function discussion read.
sources.finding: Essential features need sufficient detail; broad claims need enabling coverage without undue burden; structure and function must be explained.
sources.limit: A beginner tutorial is an educational extension; the legal addressee is the person skilled in the art.

sources.title: EPC Article84 — claims
sources.readingDepth: Full short operative claims provision read.
sources.finding: Claims define protection sought and must be clear, concise and supported by the description.
sources.limit: Model correlations and unexplained performance assertions do not create claim support.

sources.title: USPTO MPEP §2164 — Enablement requirement
sources.section: §2164 opening discussion: make/use and undue experimentation
sources.readingDepth: Selected opening enablement discussion and undue-experimentation passages read.
sources.finding: Claims define the invention to enable; sufficient making/using information is required without undue experimentation.
sources.limit: No conclusion that a hypothetical setup satisfies 35 USC112(a); later case law beyond passages read was not exhaustively audited.

sources.title: EPO President decision7July2025 — OJ2025A49
sources.readingDepth: Operative drawing/presentation articles, supersession and effective-date provisions read.
sources.finding: Effective1October2025: A4, margins, ≥3.2mm drawing characters, minimal text; electronic colour/greyscale permitted subject to contrast and300dpi suitability.
sources.limit: Technical profile alignment is not certification, acceptance, sufficiency or a claim of EU-wide harmonised patent law.

sources.title: EPO notice5September2025 — colour/greyscale drawings, OJ2025A57
sources.readingDepth: Selected Euro-direct, PCT and Euro-PCT transition paragraphs read.
sources.finding: EPO electronic colour is permitted under A49; PCT international-phase colour remains inadmissible; Euro-PCT transition depends on dates and PATENTSCOPE availability.
sources.limit: Do not generalise EPO electronic colour permission to every office, paper filing or PCT international publication.

sources.title: EPC Article123 — amendments
sources.readingDepth: Selected no-added-subject-matter and post-grant scope provisions read.
sources.finding: An amended European application/patent may not extend beyond the content as filed; post-grant protection may not be extended.
sources.limit: An educational later drawing is not a reconstruction of what an earlier patent application disclosed.

sources.title: 37 CFR §1.71 — Detailed description and specification
sources.readingDepth: Current eCFR title as of 13 November 2026; selected description paragraphs read.
sources.finding: Describe making and using in full, clear, concise and exact terms sufficient for a person skilled in the art.
sources.limit: Not an assessment that any repository proposal is enabled or patentable.

requirements.label: Drawing sheet size
requirements.rule: US §1.84(f): A4 210×297mm or US Letter216×279mm; EPO A49Art2(2)/PCT11.5 use A4 (PCT receiving-office exception does not alter A4 record-copy rule).

requirements.label: Drawing margins and sight
requirements.rule: US1.84(g), A49Art1(1), PCT11.6(c): minimum top25,left25,right15,bottom10mm; A4 sight no greater than170×262mm; no frame around usable area.

requirements.label: Reference-number and letter height
requirements.rule: US1.84(p)(3), A49Art1(2)(g), PCT11.13(h): drawing numbers/letters at least3.2mm high. Do not substitute EPO2.1mm description text minimum.

requirements.label: Two-thirds reproduction readability
requirements.rule: US1.84(k), A49Art1(2)(c), PCT11.13(c): details remain distinguishable after linear reduction to two-thirds; requires actual legibility review, not only a numeric SVG test.

requirements.label: Monochrome common profile
requirements.rule: US1.84(a),(l) and PCT11.13(a) support black-line default. A49Art1(2)(a) allows electronically filed colour/greyscale with contrast/300dpi suitability; monochrome here is a conservative profile choice.

requirements.label: Keep lengthy explanation off drawing sheet
requirements.rule: A49Art1(2)(j), PCT11.11 permit only indispensable short words; keep full definitions, products and teaching prose in separate description/reference documents.

requirements.label: Stable reference signs and cross-reference legend
requirements.rule: US1.84(p)(4)–(5), A49Art1(2)(i), PCT11.13(l)–(n): same feature uses same sign; drawing/description references correspond; separate feature list is useful.

requirements.label: Unambiguous leader lines
requirements.rule: US1.84(q): short lines from near character to feature, noncrossing; surface/section exception uses underline. Reference signs must not obscure drawing lines/hatching.

requirements.label: Sufficient distinct views
requirements.rule: US1.84(h)–(j), A49Art1(2)(h), PCT11.13(i)–(k): necessary views separated, not overlapping; partial views assemble without obscuring detail.

requirements.label: Figure and sheet numbers are separate
requirements.rule: US1.84(u): sequential FIG.1 etc, larger than reference signs; a single-view US application must have neither view number nor FIG. EPO/PCT sequential Arabic figure numbering is independent of sheets.

requirements.label: Sheet numbering placement
requirements.rule: US1.84(t): if present, sheet/total format and larger than reference characters within sight; EPOA49Art2(5) top-centred not in margin; PCT11.7 top/bottom-centred not margin.

requirements.label: US scan targets are recommended, not mandatory
requirements.rule: US1.84(g) says sheets should have scan target crosshairs on two catercorner margin corners. This is not a four-marker must requirement and not an EPO/PCT common mandate.

requirements.label: Cross-section hatching
requirements.rule: US1.84(h)(3), A49Art1(2)(b), PCT11.13(b): hatching should remain distinguishable and not impede reference signs/leaders. No section/material is inferred where source geometry is absent.

requirements.label: Proportions and scale indications
requirements.rule: US1.84(k) prohibits actual-size/scale1/2 indications. EPO/PCT exceptional scale indications use a graphic scale; preserve proportions unless a clarity exception is explicit.

requirements.label: Separate description structure
requirements.rule: EPC Rule42(1)(a)–(f): field, useful known background, problem/solution and advantageous effects, brief figures, at least one detailed way of carrying out, industrial applicability when not obvious. US1.71(a)–(c) asks full/clear making-and-using description.

requirements.label: Define symbols and reference features without changing conventions
requirements.rule: Explain source-dependent units, peak/RMS conventions and feature functions in the description/reference table; distinguish this educational completeness policy from a claim that every symbol is legally prescribed.

requirements.label: Claim language and support
requirements.rule: EPC Art84 and Rule43: clear concise supported technical features, proper dependency/numbering; claims cannot merely say as shown in a figure; reference signs in claims are parenthesised where useful.

requirements.label: Enablement is separate from drawing mechanics
requirements.rule: US1.71/MPEP2164 and EPCArt83/F-III1 require sufficient making/using information for a skilled person without undue experimentation/burden. Unknown essential turns/ratings/calibration or unproven effects remain gaps, not invented values.

requirements.label: Later drawings cannot silently add original disclosure
requirements.rule: MPEP608.02 quotes35USC113/37CFR1.81(d): later drawings cannot cure missing enabling disclosure or supplement original claim scope. EPCArt123(2) forbids extension beyond content as filed; label new educational geometry as new authored material.

requirements.label: Proposed examples and operated setups remain separate
requirements.rule: For this product, record whether an example is a source assertion, hypothetical procedure, deterministic model or measured apparatus. No mechanical-sheet check establishes physical validation or claim sufficiency.

requirements.label: Scratch setup document is an educational extension
requirements.rule: A reader setup guide should list known components, tools, units, prerequisites, interfaces, measurement/calibration plan, controls and missing specifications; standards address the skilled person, not a guarantee of novice buildability.

commonProfile.label: Conservative A4 monochrome documentation profile
commonProfile.colourChoice: Black lines/white background chosen for shared-profile portability, not an EPO electronic-colour prohibition.

lineWidthMm.limit: The cited provisions specify durable/reproducible lines, not a universal0.25mm stroke requirement.

commonProfile.assumedFigureSet: Multiple figures; USsingle-view exception must be handled separately.
commonProfile.descriptionTextNote: EPOA49Art2(7) capital-height2.1mm/1.5spacing differs from3.2mm drawing glyphs; PCT11.9(d) ordinarytext2.8mm (requesttext2.1mm exception).
automatedChecksCannotShow: enablement or claims supported over their whole scope
office filing acceptance or legal compliance certification
legibility of every semantic detail without actual rendered review

legalHistory.successor: Presentation authority moved to President decisions underRule49(2)

limitations: Selected operative provisions and passages were read; this is not an exhaustive audit of all patent law, prosecution procedures, national offices or later changes.
The sheet profile does not certify legal filing compliance, novelty, sufficiency, physical performance or manufacturing readiness.
Current pages sometimes retain deleted/struck historical wording; the current2025Presidentdecision was cross-checked rather than treating historicalRule46 as operative.
